review_type: independent bounded code review by an OpenCode general-purpose subagent; no Luna model was available in this harness, so no Luna identity is claimed

findings.summary: authentic_capture could be forged with a locally registered self-authored receipt
findings.disposition: fixed: authentic_capture is Literal[False]; declared_owned_capture records the claim; blockers retain the self-asserted-capture warning and require_authentic_producer always refuses

findings.summary: positional-layout values are not semantically validated
findings.disposition: documented limitation: exact byte length, entry count and width are bound; values are not interpreted

findings.summary: boundary_token_count allowed zero despite the expanded-boundary contract
findings.disposition: fixed: minimum one boundary token required

findings.summary: exported bytes were normalised rather than hash-verified
findings.disposition: fixed: export accepts only exact registered canonical trace bytes

findings.summary: caller-supplied RequestProjection internal hashes were trusted
findings.disposition: fixed: body and image-bindings hashes are recomputed

findings.summary: NativeTraceGate had no cross-field consistency check
findings.disposition: fixed: model validator ties validity to trace/digest presence and producer kind

findings.summary: require_authentic_producer declared a return type it never returned
findings.disposition: fixed: NoReturn with explicit authored/owned refusal messages

findings.summary: imprecise out-of-range media index and unwrapped exporter exceptions
findings.disposition: fixed: explicit missing-segment error and failed-gate wrapping

findings.summary: test coverage gaps for several validators and the explicit ceiling branch
findings.disposition: fixed: 15 added cases cover segment kind/order, duplicate media, boundary tokens, media counts, grid/shape arithmetic, positions width, projection drift, exact export bytes, gate consistency and unregistered receipts; the redundant post-equality ceiling branch was removed because field caps already enforce 6000

confirmed_sound: launch_clearance and launch_ready cannot be constructed true
expanded-stream, media, text-tiling and grid invariants are enforced
registry lookups re-hash actual bytes and require canonical registered artifacts
v1 module and the 6000/1500 caps are unchanged
